GEOGRAPHY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #16
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: GEOGRAPHY
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Oceans, Seas and Coasts is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Oceans, Seas and Coasts as rumours only.
   B. Explain Oceans, Seas and Coasts with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Oceans, Seas and Coasts.
   D. Say Oceans, Seas and Coasts never happens in Kenya.

2. Which statement about Elementary Surveying is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Elementary Surveying with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Elementary Surveying as rumours only.
   C. Say Elementary Surveying never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Elementary Surveying.

3. Which statement about Statistical Methods is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Statistical Methods as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Statistical Methods.
   C. Say Statistical Methods never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Statistical Methods with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

4. Which statement about Underground Water is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Underground Water as rumours only.
   B. Explain Underground Water with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Underground Water never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Underground Water.

5. Which statement about Action of wind and water in arid areas is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Action of wind and water in arid areas.
   B. Treat Action of wind and water in arid areas as rumours only.
   C. Explain Action of wind and water in arid areas with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Action of wind and water in arid areas never happens in Kenya.

6. Which statement about Karst Scenery is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Karst Scenery never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Karst Scenery with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Karst Scenery as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Karst Scenery.

7. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore prices in shops
   B. Hide all money underground
   C. Avoid saving forever
   D. Plan income and spending wisely

8. Which statement about Geographic Information Systems is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Geographic Information Systems as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Geographic Information Systems.
   C. Explain Geographic Information Systems with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Geographic Information Systems never happens in Kenya.

9. Which statement about Fishing is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Fishing with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Fishing.
   C. Treat Fishing as rumours only.
   D. Say Fishing never happens in Kenya.

10. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nakuru
   B. Nairobi
   C. Mombasa
   D. Kisumu

11. Which statement about Lakes is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Lakes with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Lakes as rumours only.
   C. Say Lakes never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Lakes.

12. Which statement about Glaciation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Glaciation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Glaciation.
   C. Say Glaciation never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Glaciation as rumours only.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Statistical Methods and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Elementary Surveying and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Geographic Information Systems and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Action of wind and water in arid areas and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
